title: 黄仁勋先辞后回：董事会全票复职，合规架构调整会怎么落地？
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: What does this mean for NVIDIA? NVIDIA is just simply too dependent on Jens and Huang.
segments.zh: 这对英伟达意味着什么？英伟达过于依赖黄仁勋。

segments.en: And this is reinstatement. I mean, just highlight how difficult it is for the company.
segments.zh: 这次复职，恰恰凸显了公司面临的困难。

segments.en: This be a month of a company to move forward. That Jens and Huang are doing.
segments.zh: 公司需要一个月的时间来推进，这正是黄仁勋在做的。

segments.en: In a statement that's light on detail, where there is new information substances that there are some sort of lasting governance changes.
segments.zh: 一份细节不多的声明中，新信息表明存在某种持久的治理变革。

segments.en: I think that is absolutely critical. They are going to search for a new chief compliance officer.
segments.zh: 我认为这至关重要。他们将寻找新的首席合规官。

segments.en: And the idea that Harvey C. Jones, who has himself been a director since 1993, but was the first chair of the board.
segments.zh: 哈维·C·琼斯自1993年起担任董事，曾是董事会首任主席。

segments.en: When Jens and Huang, before all of this, took place, was there.
segments.zh: 在黄仁勋这一切发生之前，他就在那里。

segments.en: He held the title of CEO and president, which he takes back, and was a director on the board.
segments.zh: 他曾拥有CEO和总裁的头衔，现在重新拿回，并担任董事会董事。

segments.en: And de facto, he basically was CEO chair, though he didn't have the chair title.
segments.zh: 实际上，他基本就是CEO主席，尽管没有主席头衔。

segments.en: So that was the major change. And Harvey C. Jones stays at chairman.
segments.zh: 这就是重大变化。哈维·C·琼斯继续担任董事长。

segments.en: But clearly, there was an acknowledgement in the two or three times that the board communicated
segments.zh: 但显然，董事会在两三次沟通中承认了这一点

segments.en: over that 10-day period, or 11-day periods, in Jens and Huang resigned, where they acknowledge the company has a responsibility to know where its technology
segments.zh: 在那10天或11天期间，黄仁勋辞职时，他们承认公司有责任了解其技术

segments.en: is going, who is using that technology. And that's why they set up that board-level permanent committee structure.
segments.zh: 走向何方，谁在使用该技术。因此他们设立了董事会级别的常设委员会结构。

segments.en: All of that remains in place with the what happens next, being changes to the org that runs compliance.
segments.zh: 所有这些仍然有效，接下来是对合规运营组织进行调整。
